notes:
Patch 0.1.5

Updates
- Apply waits until Manafall is fully closed before it copies files. Do not click Manafall.exe while the PowerShell window is open. Wait until it says Done.

Play
- Class pick waits until loading is finished. You do not spawn in the world, underwater, or in limbo before you choose.
- Pause holds Settings. Screen border lives there.
- Chat: Enter to type, Enter to send. While the box is open, movement and look keys do not fire. Esc closes chat without opening pause on the same press.
- Hold Insert to see who is on this server.
- Other players' walk and attack clips play through instead of freezing on the first frame.
- After death you keep the starter rock. Other items and stats reset.
- Starts fullscreen. Change that in Settings.

World
- Mushroom fairies spawn in forest and swamp.
- Copper, Highborn, and Laventian chausses cover waist and legs. Blacksmith recipes make them.
- Heat: armor cooks you faster. Cloth shades you better than skin. High heat drinks water, then blacks you out, then can kill you before health hits zero.
- Mana Fall weather: slow glowing fall, sounds dampen, max mana and recharge rise a little.
- Copper stone looks like its icon, can cluster up to five, and respawns in the same place.
- Trees vary in size. Some rocks are very large.
- Foundations snap to neighbors. Two connected floors share one wall, not a wall per pad.
- Host no longer stands on a floating invisible floor. Hidden collision from missing rocks is cleared.

Look and sound
- Looking up stays sharp. Clouds no longer blur the whole scene.
- Mouse locks after spawn. Chat and loading screens do not steal the cursor.
- Clouds sit behind trees. Night clouds go dark. Storms and sandstorms fade in and out, including the sound.
- Stars rotate with the night and do not flash like old television static.
- Birds quiet from dusk and are silent by 1 AM.
- Menu music, wind, and rain play in the Windows build.
